description: Workday customer tax ID type values for the AR customer template. Snapshot of the CCS `FA E2E Customers V1.xlsm` country-specific `*_Tax_Type` named ranges, keyed by ISO country code so `Tax ID Type` can cascade from `Tax ID Country Code`. Where the workbook exposes no country-specific range, the migration SQL fallback is used (`TIN`, or the mapped default where one exists).
provenance: Transcribed 2026-07-22 from `/Users/Rakesh.Patel/Documents/__data/excel/threeplus/CCS/FA E2E Customers V1.xlsm` tax-type named ranges (for example `United_Kingdom_Tax_Type`, `France_Tax_Type`). Fallback rows for countries with no workbook range follow `elt_ingest_excel/config/transform/sql/finance/customer/workday_customer_tax.sql` and `elt_ingest_excel/config/data/ref_country_tax_id_type_mapping.json`. Snapshot only, not a live link.
